title: feature request: task manager has option to show tasks from other desktops
line: The Task Manager's "Show tasks" settings can now show only tasks from other desktops, activities or screens, so two task managers can split current and other windows.
explanation: The task manager's filters were on/off switches that could only keep tasks on the current virtual desktop, activity or screen, so there was no way to list only the windows on other desktops. Open MRs plasma-workspace!6854 and plasma-desktop!3888 (Jakub Sirek) turn each filter into a mode (all, current or other) in libtaskmanager, and replace the "Show only tasks" checkboxes with combo boxes, migrating existing settings with a kconf_update script.

commits.message:
libtaskmanager: Allow filtering tasks from other desktops and screens

The filters could only keep tasks on the current virtual desktop, screen
or activity. They now take a mode (all, current or other), so a second
task manager can list only the windows that are somewhere else.

BUG: 450545

applets/taskmanager: Offer showing tasks from other desktops

The "Show only tasks" checkboxes could only limit the list to the current
desktop, activity or screen. They become combo boxes that also offer the
other ones, and existing settings are migrated to the new keys.

BUG: 450545

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Jakub Sirek <jakub.s.sirek@gmx.de>
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-KDE-Accepted-GPL
+
+import re
+import io
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+# update of four filter properties in task managers. The name of the property should be changed, as well as type of value from bool to int
+
+APPLETS= [
+    "plugin=org.kde.plasma.icontasks",
+    "plugin=org.kde.plasma.taskmanager"
+]
+
+PROPERTIES = [
+    "showOnlyCurrentDesktop=",
+    "showOnlyCurrentActivity=",
+    "showOnlyCurrentScreen=",
+    "showOnlyMinimized=",
+]
+
+NEW_PROPERTIES = {
+    "showOnlyCurrentDesktop=": "showItemsForVirtualDesktops=",
+    "showOnlyCurrentActivity=": "showItemsForActivities=",
+    "showOnlyCurrentScreen=" : "showItemsForScreen=",
+    "showOnlyMinimized=" : "showItemsForMinimizedWindows=",
+}
+
+# find properties file
+proc = subprocess.Popen(
+    [
+        "@QTPATHS_PATH@",
+        "--locate-file",
+        "ConfigLocation",
+        "plasma-org.kde.plasma.desktop-appletsrc",
+    ],
+    stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+)
+if proc.wait(3) != 0:
+    sys.exit(1)
+
+for line in io.TextIOWrapper(proc.stdout, encoding="utf-8"):
+    appletsrcPath = line.removesuffix("\n")
+
+if len(appletsrcPath) == 0 or not appletsrcPath.endswith("appletsrc"):
+    # something is wrong
+    exit()
+
+with open(appletsrcPath, "r+") as appletsrc:
+    inputLines = appletsrc.readlines()
+
+    # Find groupIds where properties should be changed
+    groupIds = []
+    currentGroup = None
+    for line in inputLines:
+        if line.startswith("["):
+            currentGroup = line.strip()
+
+        if line.strip() in APPLETS:
+            groupIds.append(currentGroup+"[Configuration][General]")
+
+    # Rewrite lines with specific properties
+    outputLines = []
+    currentGroup = None
+    for line in inputLines:
+        lineChanged = False
+
+        if line.startswith("["):
+            currentGroup = line.strip()
+
+        if currentGroup in groupIds:
+            for property in PROPERTIES:
+                if not line.startswith(property):
+                    continue
+
+                value = line.removeprefix(property).strip()
+                outputLines += NEW_PROPERTIES[property] + ("0" if value=="false" else "1") +"\n"
+                lineChanged = True
+
+        if not lineChanged:
+            outputLines += line
+
+    appletsrc.truncate(0)
+    appletsrc.seek(0)
+
+    appletsrc.writelines(outputLines)

media.caption: Master: the settings only offer "From the current desktop" (on or off)
Patched: "Show tasks" combo boxes with all, current or other desktops (and the same for activities and screens)
Master, on Desktop 2: a second task manager can only show all windows, including those already on this desktop
Patched, second task manager set to "From other desktops": on Desktop 2 (top) it lists Dolphin and System Settings from Desktop 1, on Desktop 1 (bottom) Info Center and Konsole from Desktop 2
